summary: Iter 256 — Validated native DGII/TSS XLSX templates + BankCombobox component. Backend: 9/9 pytest pass on /api/dgii-reports/native/tss-autodeterminacion-v53 + /api/dgii-reports/native/ir4-official (XLSX MIME + PK ZIP signature, sheet name 'Plantilla de Autodeterminación', row 5 title, row 6 Tipo AM, row 7 RNC, row 8 Período MMAAAA, row 10 # Empleados, row 11 group headers TRABAJADORES/SDSS/DGII/INFOTEP, row 12 detail headers Clave/Tipo/Documento/Nombres/Apellido/Sexo/Nacimiento/Cotizable/Voluntario/ISR/Ingreso/Remuneraciones/Agente/Saldo/Regalía/Preaviso/Pensión/INFOTEP, data row 13, IR-4 layout with TOTALES row); 404 returned when no payroll exists for year/month. Legacy /api/dgii-reports/monthly/ir4 + /tss-autodeterminacion still return 200 (tab-delimited, not XLSX). /api/employees/{id}/bank-info PATCH regression passes. Frontend: DGIIReportsPage shows blue 'Plantilla oficial XLSX' badge on IR-4 + TSS Autodeterminación cards (green 'Mensual consolidado' preserved on IR-3). Clicking Download IR-4 returns status=200 + Content-Type=application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet; same for TSS Auto. BankCombobox renders inside EmployeeFormDialog → Payment Method tab via data-testid='employee-form-bank'; typing 'Banres' filters to exactly 1 option (Banco de Reservas (Banreservas)); selecting bank-option-002 writes 'Banco de Reservas (Banreservas)' to form state.
action_items: MINOR DOC MISMATCH: The request specifies 28 DR banks in lib/banks.js but DOMINICAN_BANKS array actually contains 27 entries (002, 014, 008, 017, 012, 009, 021, 025, 026, 029, 069, 072, 078, 086, 087, 010, 058, 060, 061, 062, 063, 064, 065, 066, 067, 068, 088). Either update the spec to 27 or add the missing bank. Not a regression — just spec drift.
critical_code_review_comments: dgii_native_templates.py: openpyxl _autosize iterates ws.columns which is O(rows*cols); fine for current dataset sizes (<1k rows) but consider explicit width hints for very large companies.
_split_name fallback for 4+ parts merges first two as 'nombres' and last two as apellidos — matches DR naming convention (Juan Carlos Pérez Rodríguez → 'Juan Carlos' / 'Pérez' / 'Rodríguez'). OK.

IR-4 columns G/H/I derive total_pagado/ret_seg/sujetos in Python instead of using Excel formulas — fine for SUIR+/DGII ingestion but if accountants edit the file they won't see formulas recalc. Optional UX enhancement.
BankCombobox.jsx: filters by lowercased name + code — good. No keyboard nav (arrow keys) implemented — minor a11y miss but not blocking.
Both native endpoints share the `_require_dr` guard — good DR-only enforcement. Country code is read from company doc, not from the request, which is correct.

Test tenant comp_7bf9f34ab85e was 'suspended' in subscriptions collection (current_period_end in past) — re-activated via DB write to allow UI testing. Not a code bug; just pre-existing tenant state from billing tests. Main agent should re-seed/keep this tenant active.
